component.name: Altair GraphQL Client
component.summary: Feature-rich GraphQL client for debugging queries and APIs

description.p: This is a community package of Altair GraphQL Client, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Altair is a GraphQL client for writing, running and debugging queries against any GraphQL server. Its features include:

ul.li: Schema-aware autocompletion and a documentation explorer that can add fields to the query for you.
Headers, variables, file uploads and subscriptions over WebSocket, SSE and other transports.
Collections and query history, with import and export.
Multiple windows and tabs, themes and a plugin system.

description.p: The package has network access, so it can reach local and remote GraphQL endpoints, and no filesystem grant: collections, backups and query files are opened and saved through the file chooser portal. Settings and saved queries stay in the application's private per-app directory.
Updates come through Flatpak. If the application offers to download an update itself, ignore it and update with Flatpak instead.
